meta.title: Listening about Vacation
meta.description: Listen to short recordings about vacation scenarios and answer the questions.
meta.info: Each listening question has a Listen button. Read the question before listening to focus on the key details.
meta.author: Cheries

data.hint: Listen to the audio, then choose the best answer.
data.question: Where are they going for their summer vacation?
data.passage: We are going to Hawaii for our summer vacation. I can't wait to swim in the ocean.

explanation.text: Transcript: 'We are going to Hawaii for our summer vacation.' The speaker explicitly states their destination is Hawaii.

data.hint: Listen to the audio, then choose the best answer.
data.question: What does the speaker remind the listener to pack?
data.passage: Don't forget to pack your sunscreen and sunglasses. It will be very sunny at the beach.

explanation.text: Transcript: 'Don't forget to pack your sunscreen and sunglasses.' The speaker directly advises packing these two items for the sunny beach.

data.hint: Listen to the audio, then choose the best answer.
data.question: What time does the flight leave?
data.passage: Our flight to Tokyo leaves at 10:00 AM, so we need to arrive at the airport by 8:00 AM.

explanation.text: Transcript: 'Our flight to Tokyo leaves at 10:00 AM...' The departure time is explicitly stated as 10:00 AM, while 8:00 AM is the arrival time at the airport.

data.hint: Listen to the audio, then choose the best answer.
data.question: What is included in the hotel booking?
data.passage: We booked a small hotel near the city center. It has a free breakfast and Wi-Fi.

explanation.text: Transcript: 'It has a free breakfast and Wi-Fi.' The speaker clearly mentions these two amenities as part of the hotel booking.

data.hint: Listen to the audio, then choose the best answer.
data.question: What will they do first on their trip?
data.passage: On the first day of our trip, we plan to visit the local museum and then try some traditional food.

explanation.text: Transcript: '...we plan to visit the local museum and then try some traditional food.' The word 'first' in the question aligns with the first activity mentioned, which is visiting the museum.

data.hint: Listen to the audio, then choose the best answer.
data.question: Why should they bring a light jacket?
data.passage: The weather forecast says it might rain in the afternoon, so let's bring a light jacket just in case.

A.text: Because it will be very cold

B.text: Because it might rain in the afternoon

D.text: Because it is required by the hotel

explanation.text: Transcript: 'The weather forecast says it might rain in the afternoon, so let's bring a light jacket just in case.' The reason for the jacket is directly linked to the possibility of afternoon rain.

data.hint: Listen to the audio, then choose the best answer.
data.question: How long will they stay in Rome?
data.passage: We will stay in Rome for five days, and then we will take a train to Florence for the weekend.

explanation.text: Transcript: 'We will stay in Rome for five days...' The duration of the stay in Rome is explicitly stated as five days.

data.hint: Listen to the audio, then choose the best answer.
data.question: What does the $1,200 cover?
data.passage: The total cost of the vacation package is $1,200 per person, which includes flights and accommodation.

explanation.text: Transcript: '...which includes flights and accommodation.' The speaker specifies exactly what the $1,200 package price covers.
explanation.concept: Listening for specific details (cost and inclusions)

data.hint: Listen to the audio, then choose the best answer.
data.question: Where is the passport now?
data.passage: I lost my passport at the restaurant, but the manager found it and gave it to the front desk.

explanation.text: Transcript: '...the manager found it and gave it to the front desk.' Although it was lost at the restaurant and found by the manager, its current location is the front desk.
explanation.concept: Listening for inference and current state

data.hint: Listen to the audio, then choose the best answer.
data.question: When are they flying back home?
data.passage: Our vacation was amazing, but we have to fly back home tomorrow morning to get ready for work.

explanation.text: Transcript: '...we have to fly back home tomorrow morning...' The speaker clearly states the return flight is scheduled for tomorrow morning.
